snippet.title: Monster Fantasy | Reveal Trailer-Wishlist Now on Steam
snippet.description:
Kickstarter coming on July. 15!  Subscribe to the pre-launch page here:
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/monsterfantasy/monster-fantasy-action-rpg-cozy-life-sim-and-taming?ref=8w36b2

Monster Fantasy is a fantasy action RPG that blends thrilling adventures with cozy village life. Hunt mighty monsters and build a cozy life!

Learn more about the game on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4713940/?utm_source=youtube
